thread:
Marta: quick note — found a broken sample in runbook 'kv-cache troubleshooting'. The curl in the 'warmup' section references /samples/kv-warmup-v1.2.tar.gz and gets 404 in staging. Also code block shows `client=KVClient(version='1.2')` but we upgraded to 1.3.
Lee: thanks, do we have an owner on that runbook? @samir owns most kv docs iirc.
Samir: yep I can take a look later today. Is the 404 coming from S3 path rename or the sample removed?
Marta: looks like path rename. Quick repro: ```curl -I https://assets.redwood-inference.internal/samples/kv-warmup-v1.2.tar.gz``` returns 404 on staging.
Olivia: heads-up the SDK change to 1.3 also changed the init args (`KVClient(version='1.3')` -> `KVClient(scheme='v1.3')`) — we should update snippet to avoid copy-paste breakage :grimacing: 
Samir: thanks, can you confirm the correct sample path and the recommended snippet? I can open a PR.
Marta: correct path is `/samples/kv-warmup-v1.3.tar.gz`. Suggested snippet: ```python
client = KVClient(scheme='v1.3')
client.warmup(prefix='user:')
```
Samir: ok opening quick PR, will include link to staging asset fix and run the snippet smoke test. pinging @lee for CR.
Lee: :thumbsup: assign to me, I'll review after lunch.
docbot: docs-link-scan: found 1 broken asset link in `runbooks/kv-cache-troubleshooting.md` (line 142).
Samir: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4812 — small edit + update sample path. CI will run smoke tests.
Lee: looked, left one tiny nit (code fence language). LGTM after that.
Samir: fixed nit and pushed. CI passed. Merging now.
Olivia: awesome — can someone add a short note to the changelog about snippet API change? small backlog item.
Marta: added to docs/CHANGELOG.md in same PR.
Lee: merged. :tada: Thanks everyone. Closing follow-up: will set up a tiny test in runtime CI to curl sample paths monthly to catch this earlier.
Samir: noted, opening infra ticket to add curl check: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/INFRA-2041
Marta: thanks — closing thread.
